comments.body:
Thanks, splitting a saddle corner around the ring of faces is a nice approach. It conflicts with main in `tests/robustness/goldens.json` (the notes), so CI hasn't run. Could you merge main, re-record with `ROBUSTNESS_GOLDENS_BLESS`, and fill in the description? Two questions for it:
- In the mixed case the new corners skip the 'inside every other moved plane' check. What keeps a corner from landing outside the shell there?
- Seed 83 ends with two shells after its later steps. Is that expected? The 0.2 to 0.6 volume band in the test is loose; the analytic shell volume for that box-on-box would pin it down.
The ignored seed 6 test would fit better in an issue than in a skipped test.

Thanks for the exact volumes and the explanation in the code, that answers both of my questions. The one thing left is the description: it's still the template. Could you fill in what changed, the validation you ran (with the measured values), and a before/after of a shelled saddle corner? I'll merge once that's in.

Thanks. The description is filled in now, with the measured values and a before/after of the shelled saddle corner. Main moved again, and goldens.json conflicted in the notes a third time. I merged main, kept main’s seed 57 note and this PR’s seed 83 note, and checked robustness_goldens::all_3 on the merge: seed 83 is unchanged. Seed 6 is now issue #1494. The strip the open face cuts next to a concave edge is fixed separately in #1495.

The description and the before/after pictures are in now. I merged main again (b36b163) to clear the goldens notes conflict, and robustness_goldens::all_3 passed on the merge. The CI run for that commit is waiting for approval (action_required), so could you approve it when you have a moment? The new PRs #1495 to #1498 are probably waiting the same way.
